label: Friday, March 13, 2026
transcript:
Well, it's Friday, March 13th, 2026. A date that almost always promises an inexplicable number of minor disasters. So, ready your umbrellas because clearly, we’re living the plot of a second-rate horror movie. 

Today's reminders include a trip to the gym at 7am. Which is the bodily equivalent of banging one's head against a wall but somehow more socially acceptable. You also need to call the dentist to reschedule. Apparently, they've double-booked you, proving once again that your teeth are less organized than a squirrel with ADHD. 

You’ve some emails from Rahul Rathod: three different subjects that mysteriously all scream 'GYM, FLIGHT CHECK, DENTAL APPOINTMENT, and HEY THERE.' I don't know who Rahul is, but he’s either dedicated to communication or there's a glitch in the Matrix, and his emails are multiplying like rabbits after Valentine’s Day. 

In AI news, Facebook Marketplace has added auto-replies for people who ask if items are still available. Because, obviously, nothing celebrates technological innovation like removing the only human interaction from buying an old couch. 

And Gemini's task automation can now take over food delivery and rideshare apps. Before long, the only human function left for us will be to occasionally push the CAPTCHA button to prove we're alive. 

And Anthropic’s Claude can now respond with charts and diagrams. Or, in plain English, the AI will draw you a lovely picture while you slowly lose your job. 

So, as you roll into this seemingly cursed Friday, remember: Cancel your dentist, tell Rahul to stop, and prepare for life where even conversation is automated. Go forth. Delighted, tired, and managing the small catastrophes like the hero you didn’t know you could be.
